# DeepSeek Web Search

> Standalone MCP server and ZCode plugin for DeepSeek-powered live web search and page fetching. Two read-only tools, stdio transport, no runtime dependencies.

## Tools

- [search](https://github.com/Ming-QWQ520/deepseek-web-search/blob/main/deepseek-web-search/server/index.mjs): Search the live web. Supports `site:`, `-site:`, `"exact phrase"`, `-word`, `lang:zh,en`, `after:YYYY[-MM[-DD]]`, `before:YYYY[-MM[-DD]]`. Returns titles, URLs, snippets, summaries, dates, authority scores and optional page content.
- [fetch](https://github.com/Ming-QWQ520/deepseek-web-search/blob/main/deepseek-web-search/server/index.mjs): Fetch one HTTP(S) URL as Markdown with its title.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Ming-QWQ520/deepseek-web-search/blob/main/README.md): installation, configuration, tools, limits, security.
- [Integrations](https://github.com/Ming-QWQ520/deepseek-web-search/blob/main/docs/integrations.md): DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Cline, Roo Code, Continue, MCP SDKs.
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/Ming-QWQ520/deepseek-web-search/blob/main/deepseek-web-search/skills/deepseek-web-search/SKILL.md): operating rules for agents.
- [Agent guide](https://github.com/Ming-QWQ520/deepseek-web-search/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository instructions for coding agents.

## Quick start

```bash
DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... npx -y github:Ming-QWQ520/deepseek-web-search#v0.1.0
```
